note: The aquatic Marisa's hat: worn on the head, set down brim up as her boat (a lily pad on the water). Hat units are the land hat's model units; the game draws the hat at scale (hat_vessel.json scale.aquatic_marisa) in every form, so the set-down hat is the worn hat flipped at the same size (round, 1.0x; user 2026-11-01). Outside: round stepped tiers under the land hat's own bent tip. Set down: the base tier upright, the lower tiers pressed into a keel under the water, a dry basin inside, the brim lying on the water. Inside and outside are separate shapes: the cloth between them is as thick as the two leave.

brim.note: round; its diameter is the land brim's side-to-side width (20.26), so the hat reads the same 1.4x width from the front. Worn, the outer brim droops; set down it lies on the water (set_down), no raised rim

outside.note: worn: the base tier carries the band and bow, the land hat's tip_bend, tip and tip_end cuboids sit on the top tier as they sit on hat_taper_3. Set down: the base tier stays upright round the basin, the tiers under it are pressed by squash into the keel; the tip is pressed into the keel and not drawn

inside.note: hat units under the brim face: the opening's edge goes straight down the brim's thickness (lip), then a quarter ellipse curves in to the level floor; the pressed tip leaves a shallow dimple in the middle. Must stay inside the base tier with at least min_wall of cloth

set_down.note: set down only (user 2026-11-01: the brim lies flat on the water like a lily pad, the basin below the water but dry): the hat rides at a fixed presentation waterline, waterline hat units under the brim face (0.5 model units at scale 1.4); the brim stays level from the opening to droop_from, then its outer part falls to the water, its edge's top edge_dip under the waterline so the edge lies on the water. Depths of the basin and keel as worn

stores.note: reuses the existing 16x16 food_layer.png unchanged. Project design: tiers are total stored portions [from, to]; tier 0 draws nothing. For each other tier, f = radius_fractions[tier], R = basin floor radius: disc radius f*R, centre (x=0, z=-(1-f)*R), tangent to the bow-side wall (-Z), before the captain. Fixed hull-space UVs (+X right, +Z down), repeating at 16 pixels per block; smaller discs crop the same texture without stretching.
